youtube_title: Same Bro Games #20: Find the Fake Note in 3 Levels #Shorts
youtube_description:
SAME BRO GAMES #20. Three notes, one fake, three levels: tilt test (security thread), light test (watermark), number panel. Pause and comment your answers!
Answers: Level 1 B (thread stayed green; on a real Rs 500 note the windowed thread shifts green to blue when tilted), Level 2 C (no watermark against the light), Level 3 A (number panel digits don't grow from small to big).
The notes in this game are cartoon GAME NOTES. Learn the real features on RBI's paisaboltahai.rbi.org.in.
